edges.text: Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.
Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator; pre=True becomes mode='before' on a classmethod taking the raw dict, otherwise mode='after' on an instance method returning self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator(mode='before') on a classmethod that works on the input dict.

Remove Config.json_encoders; add @field_serializer for the affected fields (or a PlainSerializer in Annotated) that produces the same output, and move other Config keys to model_config = ConfigDict(...).
Remove json_encoders and add a @model_serializer(mode='wrap') that formats datetimes the same way.
Turn the __root__ model into a pydantic.RootModel[...] subclass and use .root instead of .__root__; parse with model_validate.
Replace the __root__ model with a TypeAdapter over the inner type plus a plain helper class.
Replace Model.update_forward_refs() with Model.model_rebuild().

Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod; pre=True becomes mode='before', each_item=True becomes validating the list items in the function, always=True becomes validate_default=True on the Field.
Move the check into an Annotated type with AfterValidator / BeforeValidator.
Replace @validate_arguments with @validate_call.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.

Replace `__get_validators__` with `__get_pydantic_core_schema__(cls, source_type, handler)` returning `core_schema.no_info_plain_validator_function(cls.validate)`, importing `core_schema` from `pydantic_core`. This keeps the existing normalization and validation logic while removing Pydantic's deprecated-validator warning.

Replace the `PostCode` subclass and its `__get_validators__` method with a `PostCode = Annotated[str, BeforeValidator(validate_post_code)]` alias. Implement `validate_post_code` to convert the input with `str(v)`, remove spaces, uppercase it, enforce five digits, and return the normalized string; import `Annotated` and `BeforeValidator`.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate_json(body).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate(json.loads(body)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.schema() with Model.model_json_schema().
Replace .copy(update=...) with .model_copy(update=...).
Replace .copy(update=...) with Model(**{**obj.model_dump(), **update}).
Replace Model.__fields__ with Model.model_fields; field.required becomes field.is_required(), outer_type_ becomes annotation.
Set model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) and replace Model.from_orm(obj) with Model.model_validate(obj).
Replace Model.construct(**data) with Model.model_construct(**data).
Replace .dict(...) with .model_dump(...), keeping the same keyword arguments.
Replace .dict() with dict(obj) and filter keys by hand.
Import Field and declare `key: Union[int, str] = Field(union_mode="left_to_right")` so Pydantic tries the int branch first and parses numeric strings as integers.
Add a `@field_validator("key", mode="before")` that converts string values matching an integer representation to `int` and returns other values unchanged.
Import ConfigDict and set `model_config = ConfigDict(coerce_numbers_to_str=True)` on `Label`, allowing Pydantic v2 to coerce numeric inputs such as `sku=10045` to strings.
Import `field_validator` and add a `@field_validator("sku", mode="before")` that returns `str(value)` for integer inputs and otherwise returns the value unchanged.
In from_sensor, pass int(reading) as units instead of reading so fractional sensor values are truncated before StockLevel validation.

Add a Pydantic v2 @field_validator('units', mode='before') that converts float inputs to int, preserving the expected truncation behavior when constructing StockLevel directly as well as through from_sensor.
Replace the deprecated `parse_obj_as` import and call with `TypeAdapter` from Pydantic: return `TypeAdapter(List[User]).validate_python(rows)`.
Remove the `parse_obj_as` import and validate each row directly with Pydantic v2: return `[User.model_validate(row) for row in rows]`.
Replace .json(...) with .model_dump_json(...), keeping by_alias and other keyword arguments.
Replace .json() with json.dumps(obj.model_dump(mode='json')).
Replace .json(...) with .model_dump_json(...), keeping by_alias and other keyword arguments.
Replace .json() with json.dumps(obj.model_dump(mode='json')).
Replace Model.schema() with Model.model_json_schema().
Replace `ProfilePatch(**raw).__fields_set__` with `ProfilePatch(**raw).model_fields_set` in `changed_fields`; this uses the Pydantic v2 API and preserves fields explicitly supplied with `None`.

In `changed_fields`, construct the model once and return `sorted(model.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).keys())`; excluding unset fields preserves explicitly supplied `None` values while avoiding the deprecated `__fields_set__` attribute.
Add a `@field_serializer("started")` method to `Shift` that returns `value.isoformat()`. This serializes UTC offsets as `+00:00` instead of `Z`.
Add a `@model_serializer` method to `Shift` that returns a dictionary with `worker` and `started` set to `self.started.isoformat()`. This explicitly emits the timestamp with the `+00:00` offset.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace .json(...) with .model_dump_json(...), keeping by_alias and other keyword arguments.

Replace .dict() with dict(obj) and filter keys by hand.
Add a Pydantic v2 `@field_serializer("price", when_used="json")` to `Quote` that returns `float(value)`, so `model_dump(mode="json")` emits `price` as a JSON number.
In `publish`, dump the model in Python mode, replace `payload["price"]` with `float(payload["price"])`, then pass that payload to `json.dumps`; this makes the Decimal encode as a JSON number.
